title: Add explicit usage trace metadata for maintenance model calls
description:
Problem
PR #243 added model usage tracking for gameplay and maintenance calls, but some non-turn model calls still lack explicit trace metadata. In review, recap/arc-maintenance calls could be recorded generically when trace metadata is absent, making usage filters and diagnostics less useful.

This is not a blocker for usage tracking, but it weakens attribution for:
- session recap calls
- arc rollup / arc maintenance calls
- any future maintenance model calls outside the main turn loop

Goal
Ensure every model call made by gameplay/maintenance paths carries explicit usage trace metadata so `eshyra usage` can accurately group and filter calls by purpose, campaign, session, arc, provider/auth mode, and model.

Scope
1. Identify all model calls outside the primary player turn and audit loop, especially:
   - session recap
   - arc close/open or arc rollup
   - campaign/session maintenance calls
2. Add explicit `trace` / usage metadata at each call site:
   - purpose: `session_recap`, `arc_rollup`, `arc_maintenance`, or another stable enum value
   - campaign id when available
   - session id when available
   - arc id when available
   - provider/auth/model metadata already available from the adapter wrapper
3. Ensure the usage tracker persists this metadata consistently.
4. Update `eshyra usage` output/tests if needed so these calls are distinguishable from generic maintenance calls.
5. Keep sensitive prompt/response content out of the usage DB. Usage metadata should remain structural and non-secret.

Acceptance Criteria
- Session recap model calls are recorded with purpose `session_recap` and include campaign/session ids when available.
- Arc maintenance model calls are recorded with a stable arc-related purpose and include campaign/session/arc ids when available.
- `eshyra usage` can distinguish turn, audit, recap, and arc-maintenance calls.
- Existing model usage tests cover at least one recap call and one arc-maintenance call with explicit trace metadata.
- Missing optional ids are handled gracefully, but call purpose is never omitted for known maintenance call sites.
- No sensitive prompt/response text is written to the usage diagnostics DB.

Non-goals
- Do not change model-call behavior or prompts.
- Do not add token estimation if provider usage metadata is unavailable.
- Do not make usage diagnostics required for gameplay startup; diagnostics must remain best-effort.
close_reason: Added explicit usage trace metadata to campaign_bible and arc_rollup maintenance model calls; added arcId through trace/record/store + --arc filter. PR #248.
